description.zh: 应用ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取。
description.en: The ID of the application. You can obtain the application ID on the Application Management page in the SchedulerX console.
The ID of the job instance in the running state.

description.zh: 任务ID，在控制台的任务管理页面中获取。
description.en: The ID of the job. You can obtain the ID of the job on the Task Management page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取。
description.en: The ID of the namespace. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写。
description.en: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 stop-instance --job-id 92583 --instance-id 11111111 --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
